    <canvas id="screen"></canvas>

    <script type="module">
      import init from "../pkg/wasm_raycaster.js";

      let forward = 0;
      let turn = 0;
      let strafe = 0;
      let jump = 0;

      window.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
        if (e.code === "ArrowUp" || e.code === "KeyW") forward = 1;
        if (e.code === "ArrowDown" || e.code === "KeyS") forward = -1;
        if (e.code === "ArrowLeft" || e.code === "KeyA") turn = -1;
        if (e.code === "ArrowRight" || e.code === "KeyD") turn = 1;
        // Strafe with comma / period
        if (e.code === "Comma") strafe = -1;
        if (e.code === "Period") strafe = 1;
        // Jump (currently no visual effect in wasm; accepted by API)
        if (e.code === "Space") jump = 1;
      });

      window.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
        if (e.code === "ArrowUp" || e.code === "KeyW") {
          if (forward > 0) forward = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "ArrowDown" || e.code === "KeyS") {
          if (forward < 0) forward = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "ArrowLeft" || e.code === "KeyA") {
          if (turn < 0) turn = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "ArrowRight" || e.code === "KeyD") {
          if (turn > 0) turn = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "Comma") {
          if (strafe < 0) strafe = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "Period") {
          if (strafe > 0) strafe = 0;
        }
        if (e.code === "Space") {
          if (jump > 0) jump = 0;
        }
      });

      (async () => {
        // init() loads the .wasm and returns the exports object
        const wasm = await init();

        // call our Rust init()
        wasm.init();

        const w = wasm.get_width();
        const h = wasm.get_height();

        const canvas = document.getElementById("screen");
        canvas.width = w;
        canvas.height = h;
        canvas.style.width = w * 3 + "px";
        canvas.style.height = h * 3 + "px";

        const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");

        // access the linear memory from the wasm instance
        const memory = wasm.memory;
        const fbPtr = wasm.get_framebuffer_ptr();
        const fb = new Uint8ClampedArray(memory.buffer, fbPtr, w * h * 4);
        const img = new ImageData(fb, w, h);

        function frame() {
          wasm.step(forward, turn, strafe, jump);
          ctx.putImageData(img, 0, 0);
          requestAnimationFrame(frame);
        }

        frame();
      })();
    </script>

      let jump = 0;

        if (e.code === "ArrowUp" || e.code === "KeyW") forward = 1;
        if (e.code === "ArrowDown" || e.code === "KeyS") forward = -1;
        if (e.code === "ArrowLeft" || e.code === "KeyA") turn = 1;

        if (e.code === "Space") jump = 1;
      });

        if (e.code === "ArrowUp" || e.code === "KeyW") {
